title: Refined Arbitrary-Target Transport Through Collatz Endpoints
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of a quantitative stability theorem for the one-block endpoint-pullback operator of the shortcut Collatz map. If an arbitrary target set has at most C N^(1-D) exceptions among the positive integers up to N, then, for every central Renyi order 1/2 < theta < 1, every admissible fixed central window, and every positive transport coefficient below the explicit asymptotic slope, its pullback through one floor(log_2 n)-step endpoint is (K(1+C^(theta/(1+theta)))D^(-theta/(2(1+theta))), transport*D)-dense whenever D is sufficiently small.
